sentences.en: With some savvy Googling or Yahooing, you should be able to find some Wii bundles to suit your tastes.

sentences.en: With a little time and a little Googling, you should be able to find just about any clock you'd like.

sentences.en: Googling Acaiburn will give you two results in the first several pages of results.
sentences.vi: Googling Acaiburn sẽ cung cấp cho bạn hai kết quả trong một số trang kết quả đầu tiên.

sentences.en: Review sites such as this are much more useful than simply googling "abdominal exercise dvd."

sentences.en: However, it may not be just friends that are Googling your name.
